title: 第7章 人心皆贪第8章 权力面前无感情
slug: 朝廷鹰犬没挨过六扇门的刀
content_zh:
人心皆贪。
清晨。
“二少爷。”李长春在客房外恭恭敬敬的敲着门，轻声呼唤。
“时辰到了？”李君肃睁开眼，眼神闪过一丝寒意，起身。
“是的二少爷。”李长春在门外弯着腰应着。
“走吧，想必信也应该到了。”李君肃拿过桌上的望月，推开门，踏步而出。
“是。”李长春依旧弯着腰，恭敬无比。
李君肃的那封信，他越想越心惊，上面的计谋并不复杂，却是把人心给揣测到了极致。
李家，主厅。
“慎行这麽快就有想法了？”大长老姗姗来迟。
他们一大早就被矿山那边的加急信件给吵醒了，外面赶路的武者都被抬下去休息了。
“嗯。”李毅年说罢，拆开信件。
“快念啊！”三长老看着慢吞吞的李毅年，催促着。
“见字如晤，家主，长老，身体安康。”李毅年缓缓开口。
“这小子果然很识大体。”二长老满意道。
“别打断他，念。”大长老不耐烦的敲了敲拐杖。
“矿山这边出现宗法境强者与疑似在操练军阵，所幸楚家楚夷心有不甘，请父亲立马着手准备与林家的仇怨与尽快与楚家合作。
在城郊准备妖兽，准备截杀楚家队伍，布置意外现场，剩下的孩儿这边有准备。
最後，与楚家的合作，请拖七（划掉）五日，五日之内，楚家戍卫灭。”字上消息不多，可念出来后，大厅氛围立马变得凝重。
“宗法，军阵，楚家背後来者不善啊。”二长老缓缓开口，语气却是说不出的阴沉。

“这信里办法很好，可是这麽挑拨离间，楚家分家会傻傻上圈套吗？”大长老缓缓开口。
“相信慎行吧。”三长老却是神色轻松的开口。
“嗯，立马准备，让李武带队，处理完后让他去给慎行护道，我去找爹，哪怕丢了矿山，李家也不怕。”李毅年拍板。
“让大哥出关，不好吧？”三长老有些迟疑。
“我想让慎行去六扇门。”李毅年顺便把自己的想法说出来。
“你疯了？六扇门是什麽地方，能让慎行去吗？”二长老第一个出来抗议。
“现在武道昌盛，朝堂势微，去六扇门就是找死。”大长老也是反对。
“让他自己决定。”李毅年说罢，起身离开。
“到时候一定不能让慎行去六扇门那种鬼地方。”三长老看着另外二人，说着。
春花楼。
“你说顶楼就是楚大力最喜欢妓女春花住处了？”李君肃跟李长春躲在巷子里，看着外面开始慢慢上街的小商贩。
“是的二少爷。”李长春应着。
content_en:
All people are greedy.
early morning.
"Second Young Master." Li Changchun knocked respectfully on the door outside the guest room and called softly.
"The time has come?" Li Junsu opened his eyes, a hint of coldness flashed in his eyes, and stood up.
"Yes, Second Young Master." Li Changchun responded, bending down outside the door.
"Let's go, the letter must have arrived." Li Junsu took the moon on the table, opened the door, and stepped out.
"Yes." Li Changchun still bent over, extremely respectful.
The more he thought about Li Junsu's letter, the more frightened he became. The plot in it was not complicated, but it speculated on people's hearts to the extreme.
Li family, main hall.
"Shen Xing has an idea so soon?" The great elder arrived late.
They were woken up early in the morning by urgent letters from the mine, and the warriors on their way outside were all carried down to rest.
"Yeah." Li Yinian said and opened the letter.
"Read quickly!" The third elder urged, looking at the slow Li Yinian.
"Seeing the word is like meeting, the head of the family, the elder, are in good health." Li Yinian spoke slowly.
"This boy really knows the general situation very well." The second elder said with satisfaction.
"Don't interrupt him, Nian." The great elder tapped his cane impatiently.
"There are powerful clan members and suspected military formations here in the mine. Fortunately, Chu Yi of the Chu family was unwilling to accept it and asked his father to immediately prepare for the enmity with the Lin family and cooperate with the Chu family as soon as possible.
Prepare monsters on the outskirts of the city, prepare to intercept and kill the Chu family team, arrange the accident scene, and prepare the remaining children here.
Finally, to cooperate with the Chu family, please delay seven (cross out) for five days. Within five days, the Chu family's garrison will be destroyed. "There is not much information in the words, but after reading it out, the atmosphere in the hall immediately became solemn.
"The patriarchal clan, the military formation, and the people behind the Chu family are not evil." The second elder spoke slowly, but his tone was indescribably gloomy.
"The method in this letter is very good, but if you sow discord, will the Chu family fall into the trap?" The eldest elder said slowly.
"Believe that you should be careful." The third elder said with a relaxed expression.
"Well, prepare immediately and let Li Wu lead the team. After handling it, let him protect Shen Xing. I will go find dad. Even if the mine is lost, the Li family will not be afraid." Li Yinian decided.
"Wouldn't it be better to let the eldest brother out of seclusion?" The third elder hesitated.
"I want Shenxing to go to Liumen." Li Yinian expressed his thoughts by the way.
"Are you crazy? Where is the Sixth Gate? Can Shen Xing be allowed to go there?" The second elder was the first to come out to protest.
"Now that martial arts are prosperous and the imperial court is weak, going to Six Gates is seeking death." The great elder also objected.
"Let him decide for himself." Li Yinian said, stood up and left.
"When the time comes, Shen Xing must not be allowed to go to a ghost place like Liumen." The third elder said while looking at the other two.
Chunhua Tower.
"You said that the top floor is Chu Dali's favorite prostitute Chunhua's residence?" Li Junsu and Li Changchun hid in the alley, watching the small vendors outside who began to slowly go on the street.
"Yes, Second Young Master." Li Changchun responded.
